+## Coverage (local and CI)
+
+- Run the combined coverage report locally with `bundle exec rake coverage`.
+  - RSpec coverage is written to `coverage/spec`.
+  - Cucumber coverage (if you have features) is written to `coverage/cucumber`.
+  - The collated report is generated in `coverage/` and includes both line and branch coverage metrics.
+- On CI, enable coverage by setting `COVERAGE=true` in the environment (the GitHub Actions matrix already does this for coverage jobs).
+
+- Serve the generated HTML report locally with `rake coverage:serve` (defaults to `coverage/` on port `4000`).
+  - To change port: `PORT=8080 rake coverage:serve`.
+  - To serve a different directory: `COVERAGE_DIR=coverage/spec rake coverage:serve`.
+  - To automatically open your browser: `OPEN=true rake coverage:serve`.
+

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+require 'webrick'
+require 'rbconfig'
+
+namespace :coverage do
+  desc 'Serve the coverage HTML output (default: coverage/ on port 4000). Set PORT, COVERAGE_DIR, and OPEN=true to open the browser.'
+  task :serve do
+    dir = ENV.fetch('COVERAGE_DIR', 'coverage')
+    port = Integer(ENV.fetch('PORT', '4000'))
+    open_browser = ENV['OPEN'] == 'true'
+
+    unless Dir.exist?(dir)
+      abort "Coverage directory '#{dir}' doesn't exist. Run `rake coverage` first."
+    end
+
+    server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(
+      Port: port,
+      DocumentRoot: File.expand_path(dir),
+      BindAddress: '127.0.0.1',
+      Logger: WEBrick::Log.new(IO::NULL),
+      AccessLog: []
+    )
+
+    trap('INT') { server.shutdown }
+    trap('TERM') { server.shutdown }
+
+    url = "http://127.0.0.1:#{port}/"
+    puts "Serving #{dir} at #{url} - press CTRL-C to stop"
+
+    if open_browser
+      host_os = RbConfig::CONFIG['host_os']
+      if host_os =~ /mswin|mingw|cygwin/
+        system("start #{url}")
+      elsif host_os =~ /darwin/
+        system("open #{url}")
+      else
+        system("xdg-open #{url}")
+      end
+    end
+
+    server.start
+  end
+end
